note.en: Her signature and one of her top choices. It gives a lot of ATK% for her Core Skill buff, 5 extra Energy whenever a squad member uses a Quick Assist, Chain Attack, Defensive Assist or Evasive Assist (constant with her kit), and up to 20% team DMG that she can keep up indefinitely.

Soukaku's signature at S5 is very competitive. It gives ATK% for her Core Skill and up to 12.8% Combat ATK to the whole team. That buff is usually hard to keep up, but each Tremolo of hers builds a stack.

Lucy's signature at S5 is a solid option. It gives 50% Energy Regen and up to 12% Combat ATK to the team, but every squad member must hit the enemy once every 4 seconds to keep the full effect. Her Tremolo counts toward that.

Nicole's signature at S5 is usable but not perfect. It has everything she wants except ATK: 50% Energy Regen, and a trigger from her Chain Attack, Tremolo or Ultimate that adds 0.8 Energy Regen per second and 24% team damage against the struck target for 2 seconds.
